description: Given an algorithm stated as (numLogicalQubits, tCount) and a physical error rate (or hardwareId), derive the full surface-code + magic-state-distillation footprint from the general laws of the Litinski lattice-surgery cost model (no per-scenario constants): distillation factory choice, tile layout, required code distance, total physical qubits, and wall-clock time. With errorCorrectionCode set to a qLDPC code that has architecture data (bb-144-12-12, bb-288-12-18; see the architecture field of list_qldpc_codes), the data is held in that code's modules instead (modules, per-instruction error rates and timesteps per T gate) and only the factory is a surface-code block. Results are reported under TWO published logical-error fits (conservative + optimistic) because they disagree by 13-268x (d=7 to d=25); both are returned. Returns an explicit `infeasible` block when no cataloged factory or code distance can satisfy the error budget. Computes resource numbers only: it does not compare against classical alternatives or judge whether a problem should run on a quantum computer.

cycleTimeSeconds.description: Syndrome-cycle time in seconds (surface-code cycle, or one syndrome cycle of the selected qLDPC code). Default 1 µs (Litinski convention; Google 2024 measured 1.1 µs on superconducting hardware). Trapped-ion/neutral-atom cycles are orders of magnitude slower.

dataBlock.description: Data-block layout (Litinski §2): compact = fewest qubits, fast = shortest time per T gate.

errorCorrectionCode.description: Code that stores and processes the logical data: "surface" (default; alias "surface-code") for the Litinski lattice-surgery footprint, or a qLDPC id with published instruction-level architecture data (bb-144-12-12, bb-288-12-18) for the Tour de gross bicycle-architecture footprint. The magic-state factory is a surface-code module in both cases.

hardwareId.description: Platform alternative to qubitErrorRate, one of trapped-ion, superconducting, neutral-atom: resolves to the 2-qubit error rate of that platform's entry in the current quantum computers table (list_current_quantum_computers). It sets the error rate only; cycleTimeSeconds keeps its 1 µs (superconducting) default unless given. Supply exactly one of qubitErrorRate or hardwareId.

numLogicalQubits.description: Number of logical data qubits the algorithm needs.

qubitErrorRate.description: Physical 2-qubit error rate p in (0, 0.1]. Supply exactly one of qubitErrorRate or hardwareId.

tCount.description: Total number of T gates (magic states consumed). The count is in T gates, not Toffolis (1 Toffoli ≈ 4–7 T depending on decomposition).

targetSuccessProbability.description: Target end-to-end success probability. The failure budget (1 − target) is split evenly between T-state error and logical (memory/surgery) error, matching Litinski §4.

name: compute_fault_tolerant_resources

infeasible.description: Non-null when the scenario is infeasible as modeled: no cataloged factory meets the T-error budget (factory and layout are then null) or no distance up to the cap meets it under either fit (per-fit distance, qubits and wall clock are then null).

qldpc.description: Null for the surface code. For a qLDPC code: modules, module qubit breakdown, instruction error rates at the scenario p and error per T gate by instruction (on the published architecture of the code).

distance.description: Required surface-code distance (odd): of the whole machine for surface, of the magic-state factory only in qLDPC mode; null when no cataloged distance suffices.

qldpcDetail.description: qLDPC mode only: the fit-dependent part of the footprint; durations in physical timesteps (the code's timestepsPerCycle per syndrome cycle, see list_qldpc_codes).

distance.description: Required surface-code distance (odd): of the whole machine for surface, of the magic-state factory only in qLDPC mode; null when no cataloged distance suffices.

qldpcDetail.description: qLDPC mode only: the fit-dependent part of the footprint; durations in physical timesteps (the code's timestepsPerCycle per syndrome cycle, see list_qldpc_codes).

results.description: Both fits bracket the model uncertainty and are returned together; null when no cataloged factory meets the T-error budget (see infeasible).
